product_description: Supply of 500 MT ordinary Portland cement, 43 grade, for RCC structural work of the proposed office building
reason: The current OPC specification covers the 33, 43 and 53 grades together; the separate 43 grade standard was merged into it

product_description: Portland pozzolana cement (fly ash based) in 50 kg bags for mass concreting of raft foundation
reason: Part 1 of the PPC specification covers fly ash based cement; Part 2 covers calcined clay

product_description: Portland slag cement conforming to relevant BIS standard for marine jetty substructure, slag content 50 percent
reason: Portland slag cement has its own product specification, distinct from OPC and PPC

product_description: Cement resistant to sulphate attack for foundation concrete in soil having sulphate concentration above 0.5 percent
reason: Sulphate resisting Portland cement is specified separately from ordinary Portland cement

product_description: Quick setting high early strength cement for precast elements requiring demoulding within 24 hours
reason: Rapid hardening Portland cement gains strength earlier than OPC and has its own specification

product_description: White cement for flooring, decorative plaster and terrazzo work, whiteness not less than 70 percent
reason: White Portland cement is a distinct product specification from grey OPC

product_description: Composite cement manufactured by inter-grinding clinker with fly ash and granulated slag, supplied in bulk tankers
reason: Composite cement combining two pozzolanic materials is covered by its own specification, not by PPC or PSC

product_description: Crushed stone coarse aggregate of 20 mm nominal size and river sand as fine aggregate for M25 concrete
reason: Coarse and fine aggregate for concrete are covered by a single aggregate specification

product_description: Fly ash from thermal power station for use as pozzolana in manufacture of blended cement, fineness 320 m2/kg
reason: Part 1 covers pulverized fuel ash used as a pozzolana in cement; Part 2 covers its use as an admixture in concrete

product_description: Thermo-mechanically treated reinforcement bars of grade Fe 500D, 8 mm to 32 mm diameter, for RCC slabs and columns
reason: High strength deformed bars and wires of Fe 415, Fe 500 and Fe 550 grades including the D grades are covered here

product_description: Plain round mild steel bars of 6 mm diameter for use as distribution steel and stirrups in reinforced concrete
reason: Part 1 covers mild steel and medium tensile steel bars for concrete reinforcement, as distinct from high strength deformed bars

product_description: Interlocking concrete paving blocks of 80 mm thickness, M40 grade, for parking area and internal roads
reason: Precast concrete paving blocks for pavements have their own product specification

product_description: Autoclaved aerated concrete blocks of size 600 x 200 x 150 mm for internal partition walls
reason: Part 3 of the concrete masonry unit specification covers autoclaved cellular aerated concrete blocks

product_description: Precast concrete manhole cover and frame, heavy duty, 560 mm clear opening, for municipal sewer chambers
reason: Precast concrete manhole covers and frames are specified separately from cast iron covers

product_description: HDPE pipes of 110 mm outside diameter, PN 6, for rural drinking water distribution network
reason: Polyethylene pipes for water supply are covered by this specification

product_description: uPVC pressure pipes, 90 mm nominal diameter, 6 kgf/cm2, for potable water supply line
reason: Unplasticized PVC pipes for potable water supplies are specified here, unlike non-pressure soil and waste pipes

product_description: CPVC piping for hot and cold water plumbing inside hospital building, SDR 11, sizes 15 mm to 50 mm
reason: Chlorinated PVC pipes for hot and cold water supply have a separate specification from uPVC

product_description: PVC-U pipes for soil and waste discharge inside buildings, 110 mm, single socketed, non-pressure
reason: Soil and waste discharge pipes are non-pressure application and are covered separately from potable water pipes

product_description: Chequered cement concrete tiles, 300 x 300 mm, for footpath and staircase landing
reason: Chequered cement concrete tiles have their own specification, separate from plain flooring tiles

product_description: Boiling water resistant plywood, 12 mm thick, for general purpose furniture and partitions in office fit-out
reason: Plywood for general purposes covers BWR and MR bonded grades

product_description: Marine grade plywood, 19 mm, for boat building and permanently damp locations
reason: Marine plywood has stricter bond and preservative requirements than general purpose plywood

product_description: Film faced shuttering plywood, 12 mm, for repeated use as concrete formwork
reason: Plywood for concrete shuttering work is a separate specification from general purpose plywood

product_description: Fire retardant plywood with flame penetration resistance for auditorium wall panelling
reason: Fire retardant plywood is specified separately and adds flammability requirements

product_description: Solid core wooden flush door shutters, 35 mm thick, decorative type, for residential quarters
reason: Part 1 covers solid core flush door shutters; the cellular and hollow core type is a different part

product_description: Mild steel butt hinges, 100 x 75 x 3 mm, bright finish, for wooden door shutters
reason: Steel butt hinges have a dedicated specification, distinct from stainless steel butt hinges

product_description: Cement based tile adhesive for fixing vitrified tiles on internal floors and walls
reason: Adhesives for ceramic, mosaic and stone tiles are covered by this specification

product_description: Rotomoulded three layer polyethylene overhead water storage tank of 1000 litre capacity
reason: Rotational moulded polyethylene water storage tanks are covered separately from pipes and fittings

product_description: Structural steel tubes, YSt 240 grade, 50 NB medium class, for pipe truss of an industrial shed
reason: Steel tubes for structural purposes are specified here, unlike tubes for water conveyance

product_description: Galvanized mild steel tubes, medium class, 25 mm nominal bore, screwed and socketed, for internal water supply lines
reason: Part 1 covers steel tubes up to 150 mm nominal bore for water, gas and sewage; Part 2 covers the fittings

product_description: Square hollow structural sections 100 x 100 x 4 mm for architectural canopy framework
reason: Hollow steel sections for structural use cover square, rectangular and circular hollow sections

product_description: Seamless steel tubes for mechanical and general engineering purposes, outside diameter 60 mm, for machine components
reason: Mechanical and general engineering tubes are distinct from structural tubes and from water conveyance tubes

product_description: Mild steel wire, 4 mm diameter, annealed, for general engineering fabrication and binding
reason: Mild steel wire for general engineering purposes is the product specification for drawn wire

product_description: Mild steel wire rod, 5.5 mm diameter coils, for drawing into wire at fabrication works
reason: Wire rod is the feedstock product and has a separate specification from drawn wire

product_description: Grey cast iron castings of grade FG 200 for pump housings and valve bodies
reason: Grey iron castings are graded by tensile strength in this specification

product_description: Galvanized corrugated steel sheets, 0.50 mm thickness, 120 gsm zinc coating, for factory roofing
reason: Galvanized steel sheets, plain and corrugated, are covered by this specification

product_description: Cold reduced carbon steel sheet in coils, 1.0 mm, deep drawing quality, for pressed components
reason: Part 1 covers cold forming and drawing qualities; Part 2 covers high tensile qualities

product_description: Hot rolled carbon steel plate 8 mm thick for fabrication of storage tank shell
reason: Hot rolled carbon steel sheet, plate and strip is the general product specification for such plate

product_description: Mild steel welded pipes of 600 mm outside diameter for raw water transmission main
reason: Steel pipes for water and sewage in the 168.3 to 2540 mm diameter range are specified here, not under nominal bore tube standards

product_description: Centrifugally cast ductile iron pipes, DN 300, class K9, for water distribution mains
reason: Spun ductile iron pressure pipes for water, gas and sewage have their own specification

product_description: Ductile iron double flanged bends and tees, DN 200, PN 10, for pumping station pipework
reason: Ductile iron fittings are specified separately from the ductile iron pipes themselves

product_description: Structural steel of ordinary quality for non-critical fabricated supports and gratings
reason: Ordinary quality structural steel is a separate specification from standard quality structural steel

product_description: Hot rolled medium tensile structural steel plates of grade E250 for bridge girder fabrication
reason: Structural steel for general structural purposes including E250 grade is covered by Part 1 of this specification

product_description: Stainless steel sheets of grade 304, 0.8 mm, for manufacture of kitchen utensils
reason: Stainless steel sheets and strips intended for utensils have a specification distinct from general service stainless products

product_description: Stainless steel seamless tubes, 50 mm outside diameter, grade 316L, for general service piping in a process plant
reason: Seamless stainless pipes and tubes for general service are covered here, while welded ones fall under a separate standard

product_description: Welded stainless steel pipes, 100 mm nominal bore, grade 304, for general service water lines
reason: Welded stainless steel pipes and tubes for general service have a specification distinct from seamless ones

product_description: Covered electrodes of 3.15 mm for manual metal arc welding of mild steel structural joints
reason: Covered electrodes for manual metal arc welding of carbon and carbon manganese steel are specified here

product_description: Aluminium sheet and strip of alloy 19000, 2 mm thick, for general engineering fabrication
reason: Wrought aluminium and aluminium alloy sheet and strip for general engineering is the applicable product specification

product_description: EC grade aluminium rod of 9.5 mm produced by continuous casting and rolling, for drawing conductor wire
reason: Electrical conductor grade aluminium rod made by continuous casting and rolling has its own specification

product_description: Steel wire, cold drawn, for mechanical springs used in valve assemblies, 3 mm diameter, unalloyed
reason: Part 1 covers cold drawn unalloyed steel wire for mechanical springs

product_description: Steel chequered plates, 6 mm thickness, for walkway platforms and stair treads in a pump house
reason: Steel chequered plates have a dedicated product specification distinct from plain hot rolled plate
